_comment: Sample C360_DATA for Piedmont Precision Components (Account 001bb00001DLtRMAA1, Package a5Fbb000000HA1NEAW, org bankinggpt). Every borrower.* figure below is shaped EXACTLY as the Customer360*.cls @InvocableMethod Response/wrapper classes return it (field names = the @InvocableVariable member names, which are the JSON keys the Salesforce-hosted MCP emits). Verified figures traced to SCHEMA-VERIFIED.md + HANDOVER-2026-07-01.md: TCE/TBE $12.5M, TOE/Outstanding $4.25M, rating 5, 3 facilities, 5 collateral pledges (80% advance, 1st lien, ~$10M lendable), 4 covenants all Compliant (DSC 1.42/1.25, Debt-to-Worth 2.18/3.0, Liquidity $8.2M/$5.0M, Fixed Asset Purchases $1.25M/$7.5M), Margaret Holloway 100% owner, 1 opportunity, revenue $64.5M, NAICS 332710 Manufacturing. Boom block uses the known ratios (revenue $64.5M, EBITDA $5.2M, leverage 3.85x, interest coverage 2.64x) shaped plausibly. Where a real value is not verifiable, the field is omitted/null so the template's gap state renders. portfolio.* is shaped as the VERBATIM Customer360Portfolio response (accounts[], bookTotals, signals, note — field names from Customer360Portfolio.cls @InvocableVariable members); bookTotals/utilizationPct computed over the sample subset; the Brightwater covenantsDueSoon row is sample-only like its account. NOTE: only the anchor Piedmont account carries verified figures; the three extra portfolio.accounts[] rows are SAMPLE-ONLY fictitious entries (each flagged _sample_only:true) for the L1 book view and must not be treated as real org data. They deliberately avoid the retired reference-mockup borrower names. UPDATED 2026-07-23 (Sonnet data/assembler agent, Cockpit v3 rebuild, SPEC.md §5): added the full `borrowers` map (4 bundles — anchor Piedmont duplicated from `borrower` verbatim, plus 3 invented-but-realistic C&I bundles: Brightwater Foods Group [COVENANT_BREACH — DSCR 1.05x vs 1.20x floor, both facilities under-collateralized], Sterling Fabrication Co. [MATURITY_NEAR — $8.0M term loan matures in 75 days], Kingsley Precision Works [MODIFICATION_CLUSTER/RECENTLY_MODIFIED — 2 facility mods in 45 days funding expansion]) and the `worklist` block (accountIds + reason codes). portfolio.signals.breachedCount and maturitiesSoon updated to reflect the new bundles. All three new bundles are SAMPLE-ONLY fictitious data, consistent with their pre-existing portfolio.accounts row figures (TCE/TBE/TOE/outstanding/rating/industry unchanged from the original sample rows). UPDATED 2026-07-23 (v1.1 amendments A9/A10): Brightwater's covenant retest date set to 2026-08-16 — an exact 45-day boundary case vs meta.generatedAt (2026-07-02T09:15:00Z) for the COVENANT_DUE ≤45d threshold; its worklist reasons now list both COVENANT_BREACH and COVENANT_DUE. Kingsley gained a 3rd modification (2026-04-08) so MODIFICATION_CLUSTER's ≥3-in-180d threshold is genuinely satisfied (previously only 2 were on file); RECENTLY_MODIFIED (≤30d) remains satisfied by the existing 2026-06-10 entry (22 days before generatedAt). UPDATED 2026-07-23 (Codex round 2 finding 7): every facility now carries an explicit `status` field ("Active" for all pre-existing ones). Kingsley gained a 4th, CLOSED facility — "Kingsley Original Equipment Term Loan", status "Paid Off", matured 2026-01-15 (in the past vs meta.generatedAt) — to prove the client-side active-facility filter (absent/"Active" = active; closed + past-maturity never fires MATURITY_NEAR). Excluded from exposure totals and from signals.maturityWatch. UPDATED 2026-07-25 (SPEC A30 + A29 seam): added optional `activity[]` (Sterling: REQUEST_RECEIVED + ANALYSIS_CONCLUDED; Piedmont: COVENANT_EVALUATED + ANALYSIS_CONCLUDED, both reusing figures already on file) and optional `requests[]` (Sterling only — ONE clearly-synthetic client request, revolver $10.0M -> $13.0M, reference.id prefixed SAMPLE- with no webLink per A29's honest-gap rule). Amounts sized against Sterling's REAL facility data (committed/outstanding/lendable-value), not the coordinator's placeholder figure, so validate-c360's data-quality sweep stays silent. UPDATED 2026-07-28 (coverage-correctness release): the Hartwell and Piedmont exposure blocks — and the legacy `borrower` anchor, which is the same Piedmont relationship — are now the VERBATIM observed Customer360Exposure responses from the bankinggpt org (accounts 001bb00001I7FPNAA3 / 001bb00001DLtRMAA1). `outstanding` is real (Principal_Balance-based); facility `totalLendableValue` now carries the facility's PLEDGED SHARE rather than the summed whole-collateral lendable, which double-counted every cross-pledged asset; new members totalPledgedValue, coverageNote, collateral[].amountPledged, collateral[].advanceRateSource and relationship-level coverageRatio / coverageShortfall / totalUniqueCollateralLendableValue / uniqueCollateralCount are carried through. The three SAMPLE-ONLY bundles (Brightwater/Sterling/Kingsley) are reshaped onto the same contract from their OWN existing figures — every ratio recomputed, nothing invented beyond the new members — and remain fictitious.

portfolio.note: Rollups are package-level (Σ TCE/TBE/TOE/Outstanding — never a loan sum); risk rating + stage are from each account's highest-TCE package. Book totals span all 4 packaged accounts; the account list is truncated to the highest-TCE 4. Signals are bounded by a 90-day window and capped at 25 rows each; overdue covenants (past due, still active) are included and flagged. Financial / behavioral / risk-migration EWS lives elsewhere in the fleet.

collateral.collateralDescription: Blanket lien on all existing M&E at Greensboro NC: ~85 CNC machining centers (Mazak/DMG Mori/Haas), grinders, EDM, CMM, tooling, fixtures, material handling. Cross-collateralized to revolver and equipment term loan.

Three (3) new Mazak INTEGREX i-400S 5-axis CNC multi-tasking machining centers with tooling, MazaCheck probing, Smooth Ai controls, 80-tool ATCs, HP coolant. Delivery Q3 2026. First-priority PMSI lien per UCC-1 at funding.

exposure.note: Outstanding reads LLC_BI__Principal_Balance__c, the balance field this org populates (LLC_BI__AmountOutstanding__c is a fallback only). Available = committed - outstanding, floored at zero. Facility coverage divides the facility's PLEDGED SHARE (LLC_BI__Amount_Pledged__c), never the whole collateral's lendable value, which every pledge of a cross-pledged asset repeats. Relationship coverage divides the lendable value of the DISTINCT collateral, deduped by collateral id. Advance rate comes from one source, the pledge's LLC_BI__Advance_Rate__c (override, then auto-applied, then collateral type). Pledges flagged Excluded or Abundance-of-Caution are dropped from the math.

covenants.note: Threshold x actual already evaluated by nCino as of Last Evaluation Date. For a live ratio ahead of the next scheduled test, compose with the Boom MCP ratio tools at the agent layer.

signals.note: Covenant / financial / behavioral / risk-migration signals are not in this tool — pull deal_covenant_grade, Boom, AFS, and Snowflake separately and compose at the agent layer.

borrower.verdict: Grade 5 and fully collateralised, Piedmont carries $12.5M committed with only $4.25M drawn and all four covenants compliant (DSC 1.42× vs 1.25×) — but EBITDA has compressed to $5.2M (leverage 3.85×) and the borrower holds zero operating deposits, so the next best action is the treasury conversation ahead of the June covenant test.

activity.title: Revolver increase request received
activity.summary: Sterling asked to raise the Working Capital Revolver from $10.0M to $13.0M via email, citing inventory build ahead of Q4 demand.

activity.title: Headroom analysis concluded
activity.summary: Prepped brief on the revolver increase ask: borrowing base is already tight, collateral re-valuation recommended before sizing the modification.

detail.verdict: Sterling is drawn to $9.7M against a $10.0M revolver (97% utilized, $0.3M available) and the borrowing base is already tight — pledged AR and inventory support $9.2M in lendable value against $9.7M outstanding (0.95x coverage). Covenants remain compliant (DSC 1.38x vs 1.30x floor) but the requested $13.0M limit would need incremental collateral before it clears — recommend a collateral re-valuation alongside the modification, not a standalone limit increase.

nextSteps.note: Re-value pledged AR and inventory — current lendable value doesn't fully cover today's $9.7M outstanding, let alone a $13.0M limit.
Structure the $10.0M -> $13.0M revolver increase as a modification once the collateral base is confirmed.
